items.description: This is the oldest standing European building in the Southern Hemisphere, located on the Island of Mozambique.
An iconic Roman Catholic cathedral located in the heart of Maputo, known for its distinctive white spire.
A historic building in Maputo that formerly served as the headquarters for the PIDE secret police during the colonial era.
A modernist church building in the Polana district of Maputo, showcasing unique architectural design.
A historic mosque reflecting the long-standing Islamic influence in the coastal city of Inhambane.
A historic lighthouse located in the Macuti district of Beira, serving as a maritime beacon for years.
